# Noto Serif SC (digit subset)

- Source: [google/fonts `ofl/notoserifsc`](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoserifsc) variable TTF, instantiated at `wght=700` (Bold).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — see `OFL.txt`.
- Shipped file: `entry/src/main/resources/rawfile/NotoSerifSC-Bold-digits.ttf` (glyphs `0-9` only).
- Family name kept as `Noto Serif SC` so Canvas `font = "normal bold ${n}vp Noto Serif SC"` can match.
